title: One macroscopic positive anchor cube localizes the known orbit

localization.anchor_hypothesis: A complete lattice subcube Q_N has side lengths at least alpha N, q_N=Theta(N^3), and rho_(N,k)>=rho_->0 on Q_N; only 0<=rho_(N,k)<=rho_+ is required outside it.
localization.normalization: Known-phase demodulation and division by sqrt(rho_k) on Q_N give K1653's constant-signal channel with uniformly bounded circular noise.
localization.anchor_risk: Disjoint adjacent pairs inside Q_N give translation risk O(q_N^(-1))=O(N^(-3)) and a disjoint anchor subcube gives global-phase risk O(N^2/q_N)=O(N^(-1)).
localization.full_prediction: The global ceiling rho_+ extends the anchor parameter estimate across all d_N=Theta(N^3) selected modes, including zero or degenerating coefficients outside Q_N.
localization.score_saturation: The uniform residual margin gives M_(F,N)=O_(g,eta,rho_-,rho_+,alpha,epsilon)(N^3) and R_(Omega,N)/4=C_(F,N)-O(N^3).
localization.scope_guard: Arbitrary positive-density, checkerboard, arithmetic, fractal or otherwise anchor-free support is not asserted to contain a complete anchor cube.
